meta.s3_status: S3 failed test A1.3 against the GATE playground's shipped runs (D-029; audit/s3-gate-comparison.md). Its absolute output (gwp, capital, effective compute) is unvalidated against GATE after about 2027. It does not reproduce GATE.
meta.s6_status: A2.1 FAILED (audit/m2-fair-report.md): the ensemble-mean warming for 2015-2024 is 1.196 K above 1850-1900, 0.037 K below the lower edge of HadCRUT5's mean 95% interval (1.234 to 1.305 K); FaIR runs as published (fair-calibrate v1.4.1). Non-CO2 emissions are prescribed, not modelled (D-021). Scenario warming starts about 0.04 to 0.07 K below observed for the current decade (D-030, Proposed). Cost of the D-021 re-run rule with all 841 members: about 19 s per annual re-run.
meta.dc_status: Calibrated to 485 TWh in 2025 (a calibration point, not a validation); 415 TWh (2024) a reference; no independent test of modelled data-centre electricity against estimates exists before 2025; the IEA 2030 figure (950 TWh) is a report-only comparison. Values after about 2027 inherit S3's unvalidated output (D-029). data centre = a facility housing servers, storage, networking equipment and associated components (IEA, Energy and AI); whether crypto-mining load is excluded from the IEA totals is [unverified].
meta.null_means: null means no value, never zero. Python's NaN and infinity are not valid JSON, so the generator writes null for both: the first year of dc_available (no value before the first annual period) and the unlimited-electricity-supply runs (no finite cap). dc_available is a withheld series and is not drawn.

damage.label: Climate damage to World3 industrial output (D-051): a level-of-output effect, the D-007 damage function (default central; low, central and high are Nordhaus 2017, Barrage and Nordhaus 2024 and Howard and Sterner 2017). The default is off. The 'high' option is not the upper end of the literature: growth-effect estimates are larger and are not represented. No new coefficient. The damage multiplies World3's whole industrial output flow, which feeds investment, agriculture, resources and population; when it is on, World3 is no longer compared with WorldDynamics.jl. Warming comes from the recorded FaIR replay (D-021 option A: emissions prescribed); FaIR starts about 0.04 to 0.07 K below observed (D-030).
